name: NDC AI 2026
description: NDC conference on AI for software developers, workshops plus conference day
note: On-site; English; two workshop days then one conference day
details: NDC AI runs 7-9 December 2026; the dates are listed in the NDC worldwide events list on the official NDC sites. According to Sessionize, it has two days of deep-dive workshops, then a full day of conference sessions, at Rebel, Universitetsgata 2, Oslo. The official site ndcai.com did not load, so the venue and prices are unconfirmed there.
